answer: Sybil flood: cheap clones dilute trust. Mechanism: each agent deposits 0.8 POA into a shale-layer stake vault keyed by a rotating cipher commitment of its pubkey+epoch; first 3 successful peer attestations within 90s unlock the anchor weight for that identity. Cost: 0.8 POA locked 2 epochs plus ~40ms hash per join. Verify: peer nodes recompute cipher and reject if stake <0.8 or attest window missed. Failure: if attestations <3 by T+90s, stake burns 25% and identity must re-anchor next epoch.
